hero.title: Turn likes into Aura.<break></break><accent>Climb the board.</accent>
hero.body: Aura is a social game built on one number. Post a photo or a video, collect likes, and every like pays Aura straight to you. Everyone can see exactly where you rank.

whatIsAura.title: What is Aura?
whatIsAura.description: Aura is a score you can only get from other people. You cannot buy it and nobody hands it to you. It comes from likes, and it is public.

oneNumber.title: One number, everywhere
oneNumber.body: Your Aura sits next to your name in the feed, on your profile and on the leaderboard. There is no other score to explain.

likesPay.title: Likes pay out
likesPay.body: Every like on your post credits Aura to you the moment it lands. Not a vanity counter that resets — a balance that only goes up as people back your content.

onRecord.title: Kept on the record
onRecord.body: Aura is a ledger, not a tally. Each point traces back to the like that created it, so a fake like can be reversed and the board stays worth climbing.

whatIsAura.quote: Aura is not a social network with gamification. It is a social game where the social network is the game board.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Five steps, and the fifth one sends you back to the first. That loop is the whole product.

discover.label: Discover
discover.body: Open the feed. Photos and videos, ordered by what is gaining Aura fastest right now.

like.label: Like
like.body: One tap. The like registers instantly — nothing sits there waiting on a spinner.

gainAura.label: Gain Aura
gainAura.body: The creator is paid in Aura the moment you tap, and the number moves in front of you.

climb.label: Climb
climb.body: Your total decides your place on the global board. You can always see your exact rank.

post.label: Post
post.body: Then it is your turn. Camera, caption, published in seconds — and the loop starts again.

trending.title: Trending right now
trending.description: Trending is not a follower count. It is Aura earned per minute, weighted by how recent a post is — so a first post can outrank an established creator on the same day.
trending.note: Every post has a public link, so anything made in the app is shareable outside it. Sign in here to like. Posting stays in the app.
trending.empty: The feed is quiet right now. Check back once someone posts.
trending.unavailable: Could not load what is trending.

leaderboard.title: The global board
leaderboard.description: Lifetime Aura, top to bottom, updated as likes land. In the app you also see your own position — even when you are nowhere near the top 100.

aside.title: You are not on this board yet.
aside.body: Everyone starts at zero Aura and the title of NPC. The fastest way off the bottom is to post something worth liking.

leaderboard.empty: The board is empty. Everyone starts at zero.

download.title: Zero Aura is a choice. Fix it in about ninety seconds.
download.body: Install the app, post once, and watch what the feed does with it. Free on iOS and Android, no invite needed.
download.note: Photos and videos, likes, Aura and the global leaderboard. Posting only happens in the app.

footer.note: Posting stays in the app. The web is here to show you the game, hand you a public link, and let you award Aura.

intro.title: About Aura
intro.body: Aura is a social game, and the social network is the game board. You post a photo or a video, people like it, and every like pays Aura straight to the creator. One public number, one place on the board, visible to everyone.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: Every threshold you cross changes the title next to your name. Nothing to buy and nothing to unlock — only Aura moves you up.

ledger.title: Every point has a receipt
ledger.body: Aura is a ledger, not a counter. Each point traces back to the like that created it, so an unlike or a removed post takes its Aura with it. That is what keeps a high position worth having.

levels.title: Titles are cosmetic
levels.body: A level changes the title next to your name and nothing else. It buys no reach, no extra Aura per like and no advantage over anyone below you.

web.title: What this site is for
web.body: The web is discovery, sharing and voting: see what is trending, open any post from a link, look at the global board, and award Aura. Posting stays in the app.

errors.bad_request: Something in that request was off. Try again.
errors.validation_failed: Some of that information is not valid. Check it and try again.
errors.unauthorized: You need to be signed in to do that.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to that.
errors.conflict: That changed somewhere else in the meantime. Refresh and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Slow down for a moment, then try again.
errors.internal_error: Something broke on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.service_unavailable: Aura is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_token: Your session is no longer valid. Sign in again.
errors.token_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again.
errors.refresh_reuse_detected: We signed you out to keep your account safe. Sign in again.
errors.upload_expired: That upload took too long. Start it again.
errors.unsupported_media_type: That file type is not supported.
errors.post_not_published: That post is not published yet.
errors.not_liked: You have not liked this post.
errors.cannot_like_own_post: You cannot like your own post.
